purpose: Self-contained file-referenced input for a later local Codex Ultra root; no hidden chat context is required or authoritative.

runtime_record_for_review_only.basis: The client exposed the model family and Pro mode to this review runtime. This record does not attest the later Codex Ultra runtime.

snapshot_context.claim_limit: snapshot context only; never live proof

live_recomputation_required: Git root, branch, HEAD, base/diff, status, worktrees, submodules, and candidate identity
toolchain, Cargo metadata, host/plugin/marketplace/skill/custom-agent capabilities and versions
current component, command, schema, fixture, generated-authority, lane/gate/model-reference inventories
installed plugin bytes, host discovery, representative runtime behavior, permissions, and exposed runtime metadata
all implementation, proof, release, and completion results
claim_ceiling: snapshot-based contract review and final handoff bundle only
execution_use_after_live_adoption: This input may guide a review-derived implementation plan after the Ultra root verifies and adopts it against live state; it cannot itself prove product behavior or completion.
